set.body: Split out of bd-01M14YJ8FG15S0R1ART7DTM1XZ per the chief's scoping correction (general/post-01M15QJ8WT5RE001AVF5WC20MS): that bead is the single JVM-only embedBench lazy val and must not carry a docs law. Scope: docs/plans/2026-08-28-m1-frozen-corpus-manifest.md only. Content already committed on main at 95979cd (manifest rev 2): per-story contaminationRisk low|medium|high in manifest and freeze receipt; high disqualifying in the untouched-test partition that decides defaults, medium needs written justification; calibrated reports state each story's risk and no default is publishable as calibrated from a set containing a high story; fame-by-channel leakage control run before any default selection (within a channel compare low-fame vs high-fame stories relative to the free baselines on the same stories); published summaries/study guides are never recall data. Consequence recorded in the doc: the five over-famous selections (gift-of-the-magi, open-window, owl-creek, story-of-an-hour, to-build-a-fire) are re-scored before set 1 freezes and the two untouched-test slots must move or be justified. Open question for the chief: whether this becomes a protocol LAW rather than a manifest selection rule - that costs a protocol revision plus the one-line ProtocolDocument.pinned update in embed-bench, and both must land in one candidate.
set.title: corpus manifest: training-data contamination is a selection criterion (fame law + leakage control)
